# Copyright (c) 2026 agentctl contributors.
"""Discover and reuse a real ghcup only inside a redirected private prefix."""

import json
import sys
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path

from agentctl.bootstrap.ghcup import provide
from agentctl.bootstrap.pins import Asset, load
from agentctl.check.audit import install
from agentctl.hostfacts import architecture, current, gather
from agentctl.result import Ok

directory, log, nonce, url, digest = sys.argv[1:]
assert isinstance(install(Path(log), nonce), Ok)
context = replace(current(Path(directory) / "cache"), cwd=Path(directory))
assert context.family in {"Linux", "Darwin", "Windows"}
pins = load()
assert isinstance(pins, Ok)
selected = replace(
    pins.value,
    assets=(Asset(context.family, architecture(context.family, context.machine), url, digest),),
)
facts = gather(context, selected)
assert isinstance(facts, Ok), facts
result = provide(facts.value, selected)
print(json.dumps({"ok": isinstance(result, Ok), "path": str(result.value) if isinstance(result, Ok) else result.error.message}))
